guarantees.claim: When key_len_i equals Key128, encoded_key[i] is assigned the concatenation of zero-padding (8+MaxKeyLen-128 bits), key_data_i[i][0+:128], and encode_keylen[i][0+:MaxEncodedKeyLenSize].
When key_len_i equals Key192, encoded_key[i] is assigned the concatenation of zero-padding (8+MaxKeyLen-192 bits), key_data_i[i][0+:192], and encode_keylen[i][0+:MaxEncodedKeyLenSize].
When key_len_i equals Key256, encoded_key[i] is assigned the concatenation of zero-padding (MaxKeyLen-256 bits), key_data_i[i][0+:256], and the full encode_keylen[i].
When key_len_i equals Key384, encoded_key[i] is assigned the concatenation of zero-padding (MaxKeyLen-384 bits), key_data_i[i][0+:384], and the full encode_keylen[i].
When key_len_i equals Key512, encoded_key[i] is assigned the concatenation of key_data_i[i][0+:512] and the full encode_keylen[i], with no zero-padding.
When key_len_i is not one of the defined enum members (Key128..Key512), encoded_key[i] is forced to all zeros.

assumptions.claim: The parameter MaxKeyLen must be at least 512, and key_data_i[i] for each share must be at least 512 bits wide, otherwise the partial‑select key_data_i[i][0+:512] in the Key512 case would reference out‑of‑range bits.
assumptions.cond: when key_len_i == Key512 (or if synthesis checks widths for all branches)
assumptions.risk: Synthesis warning, X propagation, or non‑synthesizable code if MaxKeyLen < 512 or key_data_i[i] is narrower than 512.

assumptions.claim: The signal encode_keylen[i] must be wide enough to supply the full slice encode_keylen[i][0+:MaxEncodedKeyLenSize] in Key128/Key192 cases; otherwise the partial select would be out of bounds.
assumptions.cond: when key_len_i is Key128 or Key192
assumptions.risk: Out‑of‑range partial select causes X propagation or synthesis error.

uncertain_points.claim: The Key128 and Key192 encodings include an extra 8‑bit zero padding (8+MaxKeyLen‑128, 8+MaxKeyLen‑192) not present in the other key lengths; the purpose of these 8 bits is unclear and may reflect a protocol‑specific encoding requirement or a potential off‑by‑one error.
uncertain_points.cond: when key_len_i is Key128 or Key192
uncertain_points.risk: If the 8‑bit padding is erroneous, the resulting encoded key may deviate from the expected SHA‑3 block‑message format, possibly leading to interoperability issues or security vulnerability if used as HMAC key material.

uncertain_points.claim: An invalid key_len_i (not matching any defined enum) silently forces encoded_key[i] to all zeros via the default branch, with no error alert or fatal stop; a zero secret may then be consumed downstream in the SHA‑3 core.
uncertain_points.cond: when a fault or misconfiguration drives key_len_i outside the enumerated values
uncertain_points.risk: If a zero key is used for MAC/hash operations, it could leak information or produce predictable tags, violating integrity/confidentiality requirements. The design intent (secure silence vs. alert) must be verified.

uncertain_points.claim: The width parameters MaxKeyLen, MaxEncodedKeyLenSize, and the actual widths of key_data_i and encode_keylen are defined elsewhere; need to inspect the declarations and parameter bindings to confirm that the partial‑select ranges (0+:N) never exceed the declared widths for any legal parameterization.
uncertain_points.risk: If any declared width is smaller than the slice width, a synthesis/elaboration error or X propagation occurs, potentially leading to an undetected hardware bug.
